mutants.note: hypervisor_present forced true: without the hypervisor bit fw_cfg is still read, so phase 5 (-cpu qemu64,-hypervisor with the key) prints hv=1|key=ok, m1_done and exits 33 (its line requires hv=0, exit 0)
any key value selects the self-test: phases 2 (selftest=0) and 6 (selftest=10) print key=ok and m1_done (forbidden) and exit 33, not 0
the interactive boot takes the self-test exit: phase 1 prints m1_done (forbidden) and exits 33, not 0 by the lab's quit

the restarted session shows its sign-in screen without LOGOUT to the compositor: no session|purge line, the spy keeps its window and is not told LOGGED_OUT, so phase 2 reads spy_after=ready:… and windows=2, not stopped:0x0 and windows=1

auth forgets nothing when the session client is lost (the trace still says revoked=1): the dead session's token stays alive under auth's handle, so tokens_after=2|revoked=0 and failed=session_token, not tokens_after=1|revoked=1|failed=none

a LIST failure starts the screen unheld while the trace says locked=1: case=reply and case=too_long read holds=OK locked=0 (forbidden) and keys=2 (press and release both reach the window), not locked=1 and keys=0

a LIST the session cannot read skips the purge: sub-cases reply, no_session_line, bad_count, too_long and closed read logout=-|order=screen_only|ok=0 (closed: exit 0xe5, no LOGOUT), the list_failure trace appears 0 times, not 5, and failed= names those five
a job handle without WRITE creates, kills and spawns into its job: the app's read-only duplicate is not refused, so phase 1 fails (jobs|phase=1|types=fail, exit 0xe4), not exit=0x4a
process_spawn puts the child in the root, not the caller's job: the grandchild started inside job A escapes job_kill(A), so phase 5 fails (jobs|phase=5|kill=fail, exit 0xf4), not exit=0x4a
a process enters a killed job when a kill lands after spawn's early check: job_spawn_dead's spawn starts (refused=0|…|ok=0, |ktest|fail|), not refused=1|ok=1
a manifest of 4096 bytes or more is truncated and accepted: case=4097 and case=4096 read reply=OK 1 (forbidden), list=A:… and again=ERR LOADED (forbidden), ok=0, failed=4097,4096,
a manifest whose read fails at byte 1024 is accepted from what was read: case=io reads reply=OK 1 (forbidden), fired=1, again=ERR LOADED (forbidden), ok=0, failed=io,
LOAD reads outside /SYSTEM/: case=outside reads reply=OK 1|started=1|ok=0 (forbidden reply=OK), the later LOADs answer ERR LOADED (forbidden), failed=outside,dotdot,dep_name,system,

a boot message longer than 64 bytes stays at the head of the queue and the loop spins on it: case=too_long_msg reads pong=0|holds=error:K_E_SVC_TIMEOUT|exit=0x20000|ok=0, the trace display|boot|discard=too_long is missing, failed=too_long_msg,

a STOP before the LIST answer is read as a failed LIST: case=stop_first reads ready=1|exit=0x20000|ok=0, display|hold|source=list_failure|reason=error|locked=1 appears (forbidden), display|boot|stop=before_ready is missing, failed=stop_first,
